name: Gearboy
description:
Gearboy is a cross-platform, open-source Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator written in C++. Designed for high fidelity, it accurately reproduces the audio and video hardware of Nintendo's iconic handheld consoles.

Features:
- Cycle-accurate Z80-like processor and memory bank controller (MBC) emulation
- Accurate Game Boy Color dual-speed CPU and palette color rendering
- High-quality audio synthesis recreating the original four-channel sound chip
- Save states, battery-backed SRAM persistence, and Game Genie cheat codes
- Gamepad controller support with customizable button layouts
